name: WhoisFreaks_BulkIPReputation
author: WhoisFreaks
description: Get the threat score and Tor, proxy, bot, spam and known-attacker signals of every public IP address listed in a text file. 1 credit per IP.

configurationItems.name: max_items
configurationItems.description: Entries of the file to look up per run (each entry is billed 1 credit; sent in batches of 100); 1 to 1000

configurationItems.name: ip_malicious_score
configurationItems.description: Threat score from which an IP is tagged malicious, 1 to 100 (WhoisFreaks defines no threshold; a known attacker is always malicious)

configurationItems.name: ip_suspicious_score
configurationItems.description: Threat score from which an IP is tagged suspicious, 1 to 100, at most ip_malicious_score (a Tor, VPN, proxy, bot or spam flag is always suspicious)
